expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: On the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' pill overlaps the edge of the plate illustration. Its position looks inconsistent with the pills on the other cards, which sit cleanly over the bottom-left of the image.
The secondary gray text (delivery fees, '(500+)', the search placeholder and inactive tab labels) is light gray on a white or light-gray background, so contrast is low.
The Green Bowl Poké card image has a pale, washed-out background that blends into the page, so the card has no clear edge. The other cards have dark backgrounds, so the row looks inconsistent.

The heart (favorite) icon on the '-20%' pizza card sits on a semi-transparent dark circle over a busy image, and it is not aligned with the heart on the ramen card above. The ramen heart's circle is barely visible.

expected.reasoning: None of the reported issues describes a missing Orders icon in the bottom navigation bar.
